$comment: Copy to settings.local.json and fill in. settings.local.json is gitignored because this repository is public: no tenant URL, group id or mailbox belongs in a committed file. Every value here is read by the flow as a parameter, so changing access means editing this file, not editing the flow.

notes.accessGroupId: Must already exist and must hold read access only. The flow adds members; it never creates the group or changes what the group can do.
notes.ownerMailbox: Receives every request the directory lookup did not resolve. Nothing is granted on that path.
notes.runAs: Own the flow with a service account that owns the group, not with a person's account.
